repair: Added Worker-local payload_contracts.py with exact integer payload_version validation, legacy-v0 generation, CURRENT_PAYLOAD_VERSION=1, and DEFAULT_ALGORITHM_VERSION=b4.v1.
API admin and Worker score sink producers now emit payload_version 1 without changing dedupe keys or rubric semantics.
score_batch validates before article lookup, reservation, provider calls, score persistence, webhook emission, finish_batch, or recommendation enqueue.
Recommendation producer emits payload_version, source_batch_id, and algorithm_version; v1 requires an explicit supported algorithm while legacy-v0 alone retains the historical default.
Conditional PostgreSQL sink expectations were updated to the new JSON contract without running a real PostgreSQL service.
